|game_text=Use 2 Force to deploy on your alien warrior (free [[Jodo Kast (V){{!}}Jodo Kast]] or any Fett). Character 'flies' (landspeed = 3 and maneuver = 6), may fire weapons for free, and may move as a 'react' for +1 Force.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Jet Pack (V)]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-p2-08-Jet_Pack-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-jetpack-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p2-08-Jet_Pack.png]]) show the original text (see [[Jet Pack (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Jet Pack (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Use 2 Force to deploy on your alien warrior (free on Jodo Kast or any Fett). Character 'flies' (landspeed = 3 and maneuver = 6), may fire weapons for free, and may move as a 'react' for +1 Force.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-jetpack-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p2-08-Jet_Pack.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 21) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) dropped “on” (“(free Jodo Kast or any Fett)”)<ref name="cl-1281_8-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013 and on the Virtual Master list (VMasterType)</ref>: “Use 2 Force to deploy on your alien warrior (free Jodo Kast or any Fett). Character 'flies' (landspeed = 3 and maneuver = 6), may fire weapons for free, and may move as a 'react' for +1 Force.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-p2-08-Jet_Pack-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
